subject: Mid-Quarter Pulse: objective tradeoffs, resource asks & QBR input
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Subject: Mid-Quarter Pulse: objective tradeoffs, resource asks & QBR input

Team —

Quick mid-quarter pulse ahead of QBR prep. I ran the attached snapshot and pulled the gaps that matter for our Q3 commitments. High level: two OKRs are on-track with small tweaks; one needs a scope reduction or an infra dependency to land by early Aug. I want decisions by EOD Thursday so we can lock QBR slides.

Status highlights:
- Customer Reliability (O1): Green/amber. Latency 95p is at 190ms (target 150). Root cause: cache TTL set too low & forecasted traffic spike next month.
- Unit Cost (O2): Amber. Batches are working but quantization rollout is delayed; expected savings are pushed into Q4 unless we reprioritize.
- Dedicated Adoption (O3): Red. Sales pipeline is strong but we need 2 additional GPU pools online for expected demos (Acme, Nova) the week of Aug 10.

Proposed tradeoffs (doc attached):
- Option A (preferred): Move O2 quantization to Q4; instead focus on cache and batching to hit cost targets this quarter.
- Option B: Keep quantization, delay Dedicated ramp (risks renewal conversations).

Asks:
1) Vivek — can infra confirm availability for 2 GPU nodes (NVIDIA H100-class) by Aug 3? If not, we pick Option A. (see alloc_request.pdf)
2) Marcus — can you validate the cache TTL change safely for production and estimate rollout risk?
3) Laura/LAUREN — if we reduce scope on O2, we need an updated customer comms paragraph and updated enablement playbook for sales.
4) Everyone — input on the QBR 2-slide summary for your objective. I started a draft slide in qbr_slide_draft_v1.pptx (attached).

Attachments: okr_snapshot_q2_week3.xlsx, proposed_rollup.md, qbr_slide_draft_v1.pptx

Thanks — short replies okay here so I can consolidate.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

Quick technical readout:
- Cache TTL increase (+2x) gives ~9–11% improvement on per-token latency tail in our staging traces (see snippet below). Low risk to roll out behind a feature gate this week.
- Quantization path still has ~3 blockers (kernel compatibility, perf regression on seq<64, eval variance). Each is solvable but not triaged for this week.

Data snippet (staging 95p latency):
- baseline: 210ms
- cache-ttl x2: 190ms
- quant wip: 170ms (but 4% hallucination delta in a subset)

Recommendation: Move quantization to Q4 and execute cache TTL + batching changes now. I'll open the infra ticket and link it to SUP-4129 for tracking: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3c4D_SUP-4129

Attachment: proposed_rollup.md (high-level notes).

— Marcus

Thanks all — summary and owners below. Good alignment on Option A unless infra confirms nodes by EOD Wed (Vivek).

Decisions:
- Move quantization work to Q4; focus this quarter on cache TTL + batching to recover latency and cost. (Owner: Marcus)
- Keep sales demos but update comms to avoid promising quantization-driven savings. (Owner: Laura + Lauren)
- If Vivek confirms nodes by Aug 3, we will revert to Option B and update slide deck. (Owner: Vivek)

Action items & deadlines:
- Marcus: Feature-gate cache-ttl rollout plan + risk: Wed COB (2026-07-22).
- Vivek: File allocation request with procurement and confirm by 2026-07-22 EOD. (alloc_request.pdf)
- Laura: QBR appendix paragraph + comms blurb: 2026-07-22 EOD.
- Lauren: Sales playbook update bullets: 2026-07-22 EOD.
- Hannah: Finalize 2-slide objective summary for QBR and circulate v1: 2026-07-23 09:00. (qbr_slide_draft_v1.pptx attached)

I've updated the QBR folder and the hubspot deal for Acme with a note (https://hubspot.com/deals/HD-99823). Tom — replying to you: Dedicated SLAs we'll include p99 latency target of 250ms and 99.95% availability for the Dedicated offering in the customer-facing slide; I'll follow up with legal on any contract language. If quantization timing changes renewal numbers, we'll surface a short reconciliation note (Laura + Finance) in the appendix.

Next touch: 30-minute QBR dry run Thursday 2026-07-23 10:00 PT — calendar invite to follow.

Thanks — keep updates short in-thread so I can collate for slides.

— Hannah
